## Use case

What are you trying to do, and what limitation prevents it?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the desired behavior with a small example. For a dataclass feature,
include the expected native CPython behavior and target MicroPython environment.

## Alternatives and device costs

Describe any existing workaround and relevant memory, code-size, or compatibility
constraints. Measurements are welcome; mark estimates as estimates.

## Additional context

Link related discussions or prior implementations and credit their authors.
